title: Check an Engram-recorded actor's run_id as a UUID in the host id contract, and fix three wording gaps around its table
outcome: Check an Engram-recorded actor's run_id as a UUID in the host id contract, and fix three wording gaps around its table
acceptance: The host id-contract check classifies run_id by where the actor sits: an Engram-recorded actor (such as a bind's binder) is checked as a lowercase hyphenated UUID, and only a host-asserted actor (causality.claimed_actor) as host text; or the docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md table is narrowed so that code and table agree
The cli-and-mcp.md sentence on test coverage claims only that a real receipt of every host operation is checked, not every host receipt the tests produce
The Record id row names both the repeat and the source_change accounting kinds as naming a record, and the unadmitted-observation test comment names only the host values its receipt actually carries
